scope: Selected ordinary central-support mounting for the two reconstructed cooling apparatus; not the unidentified historical mount

sources.facts: Official source plates have 18 M3 holes each. The four selected CAD centres are at X=+/-37.4904 mm and Y=+/-12.4968 mm. Local plate thickness at these holes is 5.588 mm, measured from source triangles.
ISO 10642 M3x8 A2 screw: 6.72 mm maximum head diameter, 1.86 mm countersunk height, 90 degree head, 2 mm hex, 1.1 mm drive depth and 0.5 mm pitch. Overall length includes the head.
DIN 912 / ISO 4762 M3x10 A2 screw: 5.5 mm head diameter, 3 mm head height, 2.5 mm hex, 1.3 mm drive depth, 0.5 mm pitch. Length is below the head.

sources.candidate: Bollhoff A2 large outside-diameter washer, DIN 9021 similar to ISO 7093
sources.facts: M3 nominal washer: 3.2 mm bore, 9 mm outside diameter and 0.8 mm thickness. Listed thickness range 0.7 to 0.9 mm; DIN 9021 is withdrawn.

inferences: Retain the selected 170 x 170 x 5 mm platform envelope; material, drilling/countersinking and four-hole choice are authored
Use plain clearance holes and large washers in the 6 mm acrylic, not a countersink bearing directly on acrylic
The bottom plate bears on the selected 12 micrometre base foil; actual foil compression and fastener preload remain unresolved
Place the official jack in its retracted source pose and lower the thermal/reflector reference geometry together; do not scale the vendor model
Remove legacy toy lift solids and unconnected historical sensor-lead/contact placeholders; the eight sourced probes remain staged, not installed
Screws use smooth nominal thread envelopes and actual recessed drives; thread helices, tolerance class and engagement forces are not simulated
Two jacks and 24 ordinary fastener/washer pieces are the selected initial stock; completed apparatus displays have no initial-stock credit
limits: Frame-to-base retention, upright/track attachment, shield/film load path and complete cable installation still need reconstruction
Countersink and bore tolerances, acrylic stress, fastener preload/torque, vibration, corrosion and structural load rating are not qualified
The current reference is a static mounting candidate, not a robot assembly sequence, jack actuation or physical installation acceptance
Drills, countersink tooling and hex keys for these interfaces still require complete source/stock allocation
